##exposure blocks
# directly modify TJ2025's orignial stimuli lists (18 lists in total)
```{r define directories, echo=FALSE}

folder_path <- "../dataTan2025/experiments/TJ2025-main-exp-counterbalanced-lists/!criticalLists/"
output_path <- "../exp1/!new-gorilla-stimlists/exposure/"

file_paths <- list.files(path = folder_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
```

```{r create mapping tribbles, echo=FALSE}

unlabeled_left_right_options_d_left <- tribble(
  ~word,  ~left,  ~right,
  "dill", "dill", "till",

unlabeled_left_right_options_d_right <- tribble(

  "dip", "tip", "dip",

  catch_left_right_options |> mutate(category = "catch"),

```

```{r tranform into d-left and d-right lists, echo=FALSE}

for (current_file in file_paths) {
  
  stimlist_df <- read.csv(current_file)
  
  ### transform into the d-left list ###
  updated_stimlist_d_left <- stimlist_df |> 
    uncount(reps, .remove = FALSE) |> #expand repeated trials to separate rows
    mutate(VOT = str_extract(filename, "(?<=VOT)-?\\d+") %>% as.numeric()) |> #create "VOT" column
    separate(target_word, into = c("word", "label"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) |> #create "word", "label" columns
    mutate(trial_type = if_else(word %in% c("flare", "rare", "share"), "catch", "exposure")) |> #create "trial_type" column
    mutate(
      filename_word_prefix = case_when(     #set up filename prefix based on the sound files    
        word == "till" ~ "dill",
        word == "tin"  ~ "din",
        word == "tip"  ~ "dip",
        TRUE           ~ word
      ),
      filename = if_else(
        trial_type == "catch",
        paste0(word, ".wav"),                          #rename catch trial
        paste0(filename_word_prefix, "_", VOT, ".wav") #rename exposure trial
      )
    ) |> 
    mutate(
      #rename "condition" column
      condition = case_when(   
        condition == "Shift0" ~ "expo-20ms",
        condition == "Shift10"  ~ "expo-10ms",
        condition == "Shift40"  ~ "expo+20ms"
      )
    ) |>
    mutate(category = case_when(
      #map each type of trial with corresponding left and right options
      trial_type == "catch" ~ "catch",
      label == "labeled"   ~ "labeled",
      label == "unlabeled" ~ "unlabeled"
    )) |>
    left_join(all_options_d_left, by = c("word", "category")) |> 
    mutate(display = "phonetic categorization") |> 
    mutate(option_setup = "d-left") |> 
    mutate(progress_bar = 234) |> 
    # 移除暫時的輔助欄位
    select(-filename_word_prefix, -target_word, -image_selection, -feedback, -reps, -category) |> 
    select(display, trial_type, stim = filename, word, VOT, label, condition, everything())
  
  #save new csv files
  condition_val_L <- unique(updated_stimlist_d_left$condition)
  block_val_L <- unique(updated_stimlist_d_left$blockID)
  option_setup_val_L <- unique(updated_stimlist_d_left$option_setup)
  
  new_filename_L <- paste0(condition_val_L, "_", block_val_L, "_", option_setup_val_L, ".csv")
  write.csv(updated_stimlist_d_left, 
            file = paste0("../exp1/!new-gorilla-stimlists/exposure/", new_filename_L),
            row.names = FALSE)
  
  print(paste("d-left file saved:", new_filename_L))
  
  
  ### transform into the d-right list ###
  updated_stimlist_d_right <- stimlist_df |> 
  uncount(reps, .remove = FALSE) |> #expand repeated trials to separate rows
  mutate(VOT = str_extract(filename, "(?<=VOT)-?\\d+") %>% as.numeric()) |> #create "VOT" column
  separate(target_word, into = c("word", "label"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) |> #create "word", "label" columns
  mutate(trial_type = if_else(word %in% c("flare", "rare", "share"), "catch", "exposure")) |> #create "trial_type" column
  mutate(
    filename_word_prefix = case_when(     #set up filename prefix based on the sound files    
      word == "till" ~ "dill",
      word == "tin"  ~ "din",
      word == "tip"  ~ "dip",
      TRUE           ~ word
    ),
    filename = if_else(
      trial_type == "catch",
      paste0(word, ".wav"),                          #rename catch trial
      paste0(filename_word_prefix, "_", VOT, ".wav") #rename exposure trial
    )
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    #rename "condition" column
    condition = case_when(   
      condition == "Shift0" ~ "expo-20ms",
      condition == "Shift10"  ~ "expo-10ms",
      condition == "Shift40"  ~ "expo+20ms"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(category = case_when(
    #map each type of trial with corresponding left and right options
    trial_type == "catch" ~ "catch",
    label == "labeled"   ~ "labeled",
    label == "unlabeled" ~ "unlabeled"
  )) |>
  left_join(all_options_d_right, by = c("word", "category")) |> 
  mutate(display = "phonetic categorization") |> 
  mutate(option_setup = "d-right") |> 
  mutate(progress_bar = 234) |> 
  select(-filename_word_prefix, -target_word, -image_selection, -feedback, -reps, -category) |> 
  select(display, trial_type, stim = filename, word, VOT, label, condition, everything())

  #save new csv files
  condition_val_R <- unique(updated_stimlist_d_right$condition)
  block_val_R <- unique(updated_stimlist_d_right$blockID)
  option_setup_val_R <- unique(updated_stimlist_d_right$option_setup)
  
  new_filename_R <- paste0(condition_val_R, "_", block_val_R, "_", option_setup_val_R, ".csv")
  write.csv(updated_stimlist_d_right, 
            file = paste0("../exp1/!new-gorilla-stimlists/exposure/", new_filename_R),
            row.names = FALSE)
  
  print(paste("d-right file saved:", new_filename_R))
}
```

##test blocks (9 d-left, 9 d-right)
5
```{r define directories, echo=FALSE}

test_base <- read_csv("../exp1/!new-gorilla-stimlists/test/test_stimlist.csv", show_col_types = F)
test_output_path <- "../exp1/!new-gorilla-stimlists/test"

```

```{r generate a list of 6 test blocks, echo=FALSE}

set.seed(1)
vots  <- unique(test_base$VOT)  # [-5 5 15 25 30 35 40 45 50 55 65 70]
words <- unique(test_base$word) # ["dill", "dip", "din"]

d.all_generated_combinations <- tibble()

#create a base template (12 VOT x 3 blocks grid)
m_skeleton <- matrix(c(
  "dill","dip" ,"din" ,"dill","dip" ,"din" ,"dill","dip" ,"din" ,"dill","dip" ,"din" ,
  "dip" ,"din" ,"dill","din" ,"dill","dip" ,"din" ,"dill","dip" ,"dip" ,"din" ,"dill",
  "din" ,"dill","dip" ,"dip" ,"din" ,"dill","dip" ,"din" ,"dill","din" ,"dill","dip"
), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)


for (ver in 1:18) {
  
  # ============================================================================
  # Repetition 1 ➔ Block 1, 2, 3
  # ============================================================================
  col_order1 <- sample(1:12)         # shuffle the order of the 12 VOTs
  row_order1 <- sample(1:3)          # shuffle the order of the 3 blocks
  word_map1  <- sample(words)        # shuffle between words
  names(word_map1) <- words
  
  # 執行洗牌
  matrix_rep1 <- m_skeleton[row_order1, col_order1]
  matrix_rep1[] <- word_map1[matrix_rep1]
  
  # VOT 獨立洗牌
  shuffled_vots_rep1 <- sample(vots)
  
  rep1_list <- list()
  for (b in 1:3) {
    rep1_list[[b]] <- tibble(
      blockID = paste0("T", b),
      VOT     = shuffled_vots_rep1,
      word    = matrix_rep1[b, ]
    )
  }
  rep1_temptable <- bind_rows(rep1_list)
  
  # ============================================================================
  # Repetition 2 ➔ Block 4, 5, 6
  # ============================================================================
  col_order2 <- sample(1:12)
  row_order2 <- sample(1:3)
  word_map2  <- sample(words)
  names(word_map2) <- words
  
  matrix_rep2 <- m_skeleton[row_order2, col_order2]
  matrix_rep2[] <- word_map2[matrix_rep2]
  
  shuffled_vots_rep2 <- sample(vots)
  
  rep2_list <- list()
  for (b in 4:6) {
    matrix_row <- b - 3
    rep2_list[[b]] <- tibble(
      blockID = paste0("T", b),
      VOT     = shuffled_vots_rep2,
      word    = matrix_rep2[matrix_row, ]
    )
  }
  rep2_temptable <- bind_rows(rep2_list)
  
  #combine block 1-3 with block 4-6
  version_complete <- bind_rows(rep1_temptable, rep2_temptable)
  
  # ============================================================================
  # left join with the test_base dataset retain all the columns
  # ============================================================================
  version_clean <- version_complete %>%
    left_join(test_base %>% select(-blockID), by = c("word", "VOT")) %>%
    mutate(version = paste0("List_", ver)) %>%
    arrange(blockID)
  
  d.all_generated_combinations <- bind_rows(d.all_generated_combinations, version_clean)
}

d.all_generated_combinations <- d.all_generated_combinations %>%
  select(
    display, trial_type, stim, word, VOT, 
    label, condition, list_LSQ_variant, blockID,
    everything(),
    version
  )

#separate 18 version of the test lists
for (i in 1:18) {
  var_name <- paste0("List_", i) #identify certain version of the lists
  
  sub_table <- d.all_generated_combinations %>% 
    filter(version == var_name) %>% #filter out certain version of the lists from the master lists
    select(-version)
  
  #create 18 lists
  assign(var_name, sub_table) 
  
  #save files
  full_file_path <- file.path(test_output_path, paste0(var_name, ".csv"))
  write.csv(sub_table, file = full_file_path, row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
}

```

```{r combine exposure and test lists, echo=FALSE}

expo_folder <- "../exp1/!new-gorilla-stimlists/exposure/"
test_folder <- "../exp1/!new-gorilla-stimlists/test/"
output_folder <- "../exp1/!new-gorilla-stimlists/!final/"

design_blueprint <- tibble(
  list_num   = 1:18,
  expo_cond    = rep(c("-20ms", "-10ms", "+20ms"), each = 6),
  expo_seq   = rep(rep(c("ABC", "CAB", "BCA"), each = 2), times = 3),
  key_resp   = rep(c("d-left", "d-right"), times = 9)
)

instruction_practice_rows <- read_csv("../exp1/!new-gorilla-stimlists/base/instruction_practice_rows.csv", show_col_types = F) |> mutate(across(everything(), as.character))


for (i in 1:18) {
  
  # 抓取當前清單的藍圖設定
  current_cfg   <- design_blueprint %>% filter(list_num == i)
  expo_cond     <- current_cfg$expo_cond
  expo_seq      <- current_cfg$expo_seq
  key_resp      <- current_cfg$key_resp
  
  # 🛠️ A. 讀取對應的 Test 總表 (共有 T1 ~ T6)
  test_file_path <- file.path(test_folder, paste0("List_", i, ".csv"))
  if (!file.exists(test_file_path)) {
    warning(paste("cannot find:", test_file_path, "--skip"))
    next
  }
  
  test_sheet <- read_csv(test_file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
    mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) # 統一轉字串方便合併
  
  # 🛠️ B. 依據拉丁方陣順序，讀取對應的 3 張 Exposure 檔案
  # 將 "ABC" 拆解成 c("A", "B", "C")
  blocks_to_load <- strsplit(expo_seq, "")[[1]]
  
  expo_blocks <- list()
  for (block in blocks_to_load) {
    # 建立檔名，例如: expo-20ms_A_d-left.csv
    # 注意：原本的 -20ms 檔名通常寫作 expo-20ms，此處用 gsub 拿掉多餘的 s 或是直接組裝
    clean_expo_cond <- gsub("ms", "", expo_cond) # 變成 "-20", "-10", "+20"
    expo_file_name <- paste0("expo", clean_expo_cond, "ms_", block, "_", key_resp, ".csv")
    expo_file_path <- file.path(expo_folder, expo_file_name)
    
    if (file.exists(expo_file_path)) {
      expo_blocks[[block]] <- read_csv(expo_file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% 
        mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
    } else {
      stop(paste("cannot find:", expo_file_path))
    }
  }
  
  #order: T1 -> Expo_1 -> T2 -> Expo_2 -> T3 -> Expo_3 -> T4 -> T5 -> T6
  full_combined <- bind_rows(
    test_sheet %>% filter(blockID == "T1"),
    expo_blocks[[1]],
    test_sheet %>% filter(blockID == "T2"),
    expo_blocks[[2]],
    test_sheet %>% filter(blockID == "T3"),
    expo_blocks[[3]],
    test_sheet %>% filter(blockID == "T4"),
    test_sheet %>% filter(blockID == "T5"),
    test_sheet %>% filter(blockID == "T6")
  )
  
  full_combined <- full_combined %>%
    mutate(progress_bar = "234") %>%
    mutate(
      block = case_when(
        trial_type == "test" & blockID == "T1" ~ "1",
        trial_type == "test" & blockID == "T2" ~ "3",
        trial_type == "test" & blockID == "T3" ~ "5",
        trial_type == "test" & blockID == "T4" ~ "7",
        trial_type == "test" & blockID == "T5" ~ "8",
        trial_type == "test" & blockID == "T6" ~ "9",
        TRUE ~ as.character(block)
      ),
    
      option_setup = case_when(
        trial_type == "test" & key_resp == "d-left"  ~ "d-left",
        trial_type == "test" & key_resp == "d-right" ~ "d-right",
        TRUE ~ option_setup
      ),
      
      t_pair = case_when(
        word == "dill" ~ "till",
        word == "dip"  ~ "tip",
        word == "din"  ~ "tin",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      
      left = case_when(
        trial_type == "test" & key_resp == "d-left"  ~ word,
        trial_type == "test" & key_resp == "d-right" ~ t_pair,
        TRUE ~ left
      ),
      
      right = case_when(
        trial_type == "test" & key_resp == "d-left"  ~ t_pair,
        trial_type == "test" & key_resp == "d-right" ~ word,
        TRUE ~ right
      )
    ) %>%
    select(-t_pair) # 移除暫存欄位

  #insert breaks after every 60 trials
  break_row <- full_combined %>% 
    slice(1) %>% 
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ ""))
  
  final_list_with_breaks <- tibble()
  total_rows <- nrow(full_combined) #234 trials
  
  break_counter <- 1
  
  for (start_idx in seq(1, total_rows, by = 60)) {
    end_idx <- min(start_idx + 59, total_rows)
    chunk <- full_combined %>% slice(start_idx:end_idx)
    
    final_list_with_breaks <- bind_rows(final_list_with_breaks, chunk)
    
  if (end_idx < total_rows) {
      current_break <- break_row
      current_break$display <- paste0("break", break_counter)
      
      final_list_with_breaks <- bind_rows(final_list_with_breaks, current_break)
      
      break_counter <- break_counter + 1
    }
  }
  
  final_row <- break_row
  final_row$display <- "final"
  
  final_list_perfect <- bind_rows(
    instruction_practice_rows,
    final_list_with_breaks,
    final_row
    ) |> 
    select(-list)
  
  output_file_name <- paste0("full_List_", i, "_expo", expo_cond, "_", expo_seq, "_", key_resp, ".csv")
  final_output_path <- file.path(output_folder, output_file_name)
  
  write.csv(final_list_perfect, file = final_output_path, row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8", na = "")
}
```
